query: SELECT i.track_id, coalesce(t.display_title,t.title) AS "title!", coalesce(ar.display_name,ar.name) AS "artist!", i.ignored_at FROM play_audit_ignore i JOIN tracks t ON t.id=i.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id=t.album_id JOIN artists ar ON ar.id=al.artist_id WHERE i.user_id=$1 ORDER BY i.ignored_at DESC,i.track_id
